verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing pages describe built-in AI agents for customer screening and ongoing monitoring, and for transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases to humans, so users can hand off alert triage to an in-product AI. The evidence describes fixed workflow agents (non-customizable on Starter), not an assistant that accepts arbitrary user-directed tasks, and it comes only from thin marketing pages. Missing for 10: interactive or ad-hoc task delegation to an assistant, product documentation of how the agents work and are controlled, independent or hands-on corroboration.
